newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH GDP GROWTH SPEEDED TO 4.1 PCT IN SEPT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH GDP GROWTH SPEEDED TO 4.1 PCT IN SEPT.

text.p: The growth rate of Finland's gross domestic product (GDP) in September accelerated to 4.1 percent year-on-year from 2.1 percent in August, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Friday.
Adjusted for seasonal factors, GDP rose 0.4 percent in September on August.
Production increased in all sectors, except for agriculture and forestry where output fell three percent in September, SF said.
Industrial output adjusted for work days increased by six percent year-on-year. Construction output rose 4.5 percent and output in wholesale and retail trade increased three percent.
Transportation output grew six percent year-on-year.
The output of other services and of the public sector rose two percent, SF said.
